description: Official VideoGen MCP server for creating, editing, captioning, and exporting videos and media, including ecommerce product ads and demos. Supports hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a VideoGen API key, plus local stdio through @videogen/mcp. A VideoGen account and generation credits are required.

notes: Hosted OAuth clients can authorize without an API-key environment variable.
Hosted API-key clients send Authorization: Bearer YOUR_VIDEOGEN_API_KEY.
The project repository, MIT license, installation instructions, and 50 machine-readable tool schemas were verified against public source on 2026-10-05.
Hosted OAuth and authenticated tool execution were not tested.
